title: Magic Formula 1: if
lessonSummary: Great! With if your program only runs code when a condition is true.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: three conditions, each with an indented block.
tasks.codeTemplate:
# Example 1: check a number
level = 5
if level >= 5:
    print("You are ready for the quest!")

# Example 2: check a truth value
has_key = True
if has_key:
    print("The door opens!")

# Example 3: check text
spell = "Fireball"
if spell == "Fireball":
    print("You cast a Fireball!")

title: The Comparison Runes
lessonSummary: You have mastered the comparison runes: <, <=, >, >= and !=.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: all comparison runes at work.
tasks.codeTemplate:
value = 10
print(f"Value: {value}")
print(f"{value} < 15: {value < 15}")
print(f"{value} <= 10: {value <= 10}")
print(f"{value} > 5: {value > 5}")
print(f"{value} >= 10: {value >= 10}")
print(f"{value} != 10: {value != 10}")

gold = 100
cost = 80
if gold > cost:
    print(f"Purchase possible! Remaining: {gold - cost}")
